errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that 'Да се ограничи действието на мафията', 'Да се засили данъчния контрол', and 'Да се приемат по-строги акцизи' all have the lowest frequency of 2%, whereas only one of those measures actually shows that value.
The vertical axis actually goes to 13%, not 15%.
The description does not mention the specific measurements for all visual features, and it misses the exact values for each measure represented.
The description fails to mention the colors of the bars representing the measures or any distinct visual attributes related to how the bars are styled.
While the general purpose of the chart is mentioned, the specific context of 'limiting the hidden economy' is not clearly emphasized.
This phrase could be clearer by specifying what 'очевиден ред' entails in the context of the measures presented.
